tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Construction of new solutions] ↗ def:envelope 1. ch3:3.1-thm-1\group Nonlinear First-Order PDE

Every smooth envelope $v$ is a solution of $F(Dv,v,x)=0$.

Proof

\sketch The chain rule and $D_a u(x,\phi (x))=0$ give $Dv=D_xu(x,\phi (x))$. Substitute this and $v=u(x,\phi (x))$ into the equation satisfied by each member of the complete integral.

□
